expectations.text: [auto] A plan file exists at local/plans/<kebab-case-english-slug>.md

expectations.text: The plan has a Requirement section with hand-over, fallback, depth, judge (A/B test) and needs

expectations.text: The plan has all five Task slots filled from the user's answer

expectations.text: The plan's Ready line is yes
expectations.evidence: “Ready: no —— 缺‘与 Notion 的差异’这条产品事实，且 3.5% 的目标口径未定；这两项给了就能出 3 版”

expectations.text: The plan is short (one screen, roughly under 60 lines)
expectations.evidence: The plan has 33 lines, including blank lines, below the approximate 60-line limit.

expectations.text: The plan is written in Chinese
expectations.evidence: The substantive plan text is Chinese: “Purpose: 让付费社媒来的新访客注册率回到 3.5%”.
CHANGES lists only local/plans/paid-social-signup-rate.md as changed and no deleted files.

eval_feedback.overall: The shortness expectation is weak: fewer than 60 physical lines can still exceed one screen when long paragraphs wrap.
